title: jobsearch-harness profile
description: Single source of truth for everything personal or market-specific. Skills and scripts read this file instead of hardcoding names, stacks, currencies or locations.

presets.description: Preset packs merged under this file (this file always wins).

rubric_hints.description: Role-specific wording for the scoring rubric dimensions (normally supplied by a role preset). Skills show these next to the 80-100 band.

market_params.description: Free-form parameters read by the market pack's net-calculation rules (rates, fees, thresholds). See presets/markets/<market>.yaml.

paths.description: Workspace-relative paths. Never absolute machine paths.

output_dir_pattern.description: Folder created per application. Placeholders: company_slug, role_slug, date.

company_research_dir.description: Cache of company research (one JSON per company).

output_name_pattern.description: File name stem for generated files. Placeholders: first, last, company_slug, kind (CV or Cover-Letter). '-{kind}' is appended if the pattern lacks it, so a CV and a letter never collide.

contact_email_guard.description: Addresses or domains that must never appear in a CV, letter or message (for example an account address used only for this tool).

confidential_employers.description: Employers or clients that may not be named in outbound text; use a generic description instead.

roles.description: Primary role titles to search for.

known_gaps.description: Technologies you lack; the analyser treats a hard requirement for one as a gap, never a match.

companies.description: Named companies. Matched fuzzily by tracker_query match and by the job scanner.

blacklist.description: Never apply, never score above Weak.

whitelist.description: Always surface, even when the score is borderline.

watch.description: Alert when these post a matching role.

never_contact.description: Do not message anyone at these companies.

excluded_industries.description: Industries that fail or flag a posting (for example gambling, defence).

search_tracks.description: Parallel searches with their own tag (for example frontend and a full-stack wave). The scanner runs each track on every board.

tag.description: Short marker added to scan rows, for example [FS].

countries.description: Country codes to search for this track; overrides board regions.

reject_other_onsite.description: Onsite/hybrid outside the accepted list is a gate failure.

net_rule.description: Name of the net-calculation function in the market pack, e.g. 'generic_flat'.

employment_types.description: Accepted structures (employee, contractor, EOR...). Empty = all accepted.

floors_by_type.description: Optional floor per employment type (gross), overriding floor_gross for that type.

net_methods.description: Names of net-calculation methods to compute for a range (for example eor, jdg_ryczalt, uop). The result with the highest net is shown as primary.

compare_in.description: Compare offers to the floor in net or gross terms.

never_quote_net.description: Never state a net figure to a recruiter or employer.

ask_answer_policy.description: How to fill numeric salary fields on forms (for example: use the ask, never the floor).

flag_if_required_level_above.description: Flag (not fail) when a listed language is required above the stated level.

authorized_in.description: Countries/regions where the candidate may work without sponsorship.

hard_stop_phrases.description: Posting wording that fails the eligibility gate.

target_countries.description: Countries you want roles in; onsite or hybrid elsewhere fails the location gate.

permits.description: Residence or work permits you hold. Used for eligibility lines and form answers.

form_answer.description: Exact wording for work-authorization questions on application forms.

answer_only_asked_country.description: Answer for the country the form asks about; flag other countries to the user instead of answering.

weights.description: Must sum to 1.0 (checked by jobprofile.py, JSON Schema cannot express it).

thresholds.description: Must be strictly descending (checked by jobprofile.py).

technical_floor.description: Technical score below this caps the verdict at Moderate.

custom.description: Your own gates. A match in the posting applies the action.

depth_risk_keywords.description: JD topics that historically caused rejections; if present, subtract 5-10 from Technical.

modifiers.description: Score adjustments applied to one rubric dimension when a phrase appears in the posting.

depth_risk_penalty.description: Points subtracted from Technical when a depth-risk topic is stressed.

posting_health.description: Liveness and quality checks on a posting.

signal_stacks.description: Skill signals the analyser matches against the posting.

boards.description: Job sources. Each entry maps to a board adapter (see docs/adapters.md).

adapter.description: Tool-name prefix or connector id implementing the adapter contract.

keywords.description: Board-specific keywords added to the track keywords.

filters.description: Board-specific filters passed to the adapter (seniority, remote, salary).

tracks.description: Search track ids this board runs; empty = all.

tools.description: Exact tool names of the adapter when the search / details tools cannot be found by pattern.

stale_after_days.description: Quiet this long = stale-sweep candidate (propose only).

by_status.description: Per-status windows (days quiet before a first / second follow-up). Keys are status names.

marker.description: Text written to Next Action when a follow-up is logged; {date} is YYYY-MM-DD. Used to count follow-ups.

history_window_days.description: Show applications to the same company within this many days (informational, never an auto-skip).

draft_only.description: Skills draft follow-ups; they never send.

never_auto_skip_history.description: A past SKIP, REJECTED or WITHDRAWN row never auto-skips a new role.

status_roles.description: Which of your status names play which role in the scripts (rename statuses freely, then map them here).

archives.description: Workspace-relative paths of older tracker snapshots, read-only, used by tracker_query. Do not point at a folder of timestamped backups.

company_suffixes.description: Extra legal-form words ignored when matching company names (added to a built-in generic list).

statuses.description: Override the status enum; order = sort priority, most actionable first.

stages.description: Date columns that mark pipeline stages, in order. A date in a 'screen' column counts as a reply; in an 'interview' or 'final' column as an interview.

default_new_status.description: Status given to a new row.

backup_never_overwrite.description: Backups are never overwritten or deleted (fixed rule, listed for visibility).

fields.description: Column header for each logical field the scripts use. Rename a header here and every script follows. The salary column is tracker.salary_column.

match_ratio.description: Fuzzy company-name similarity at or above which two rows count as the same company.

calibration_min_n.description: Applications per score band below which calibrate draws no conclusion.

mature_days.description: Applications newer than this are left out of calibration (a reply needs time).

cv_map.description: How the base CV is structured. Prefer heading detection; use explicit indices only as an escape hatch.

other_headings.description: Keywords of other section headings (education, certifications, ...) that end the skills block, for headings that are not bold, UPPERCASE or heading-styled.

keep_with_next_prefixes.description: Paragraphs starting with one of these are kept with the next one (e.g. a 'Key Contributions' label).

indices.description: Named paragraph indices. Recognised keys: name, title, contact, summary. Overrides heading detection for those.

forbid_em_dash.description: Reject em dashes in generated CV/letter text.

reply_greeting.description: Optional. Text the assistant starts every chat reply with (for example a first name and a comma). Chat replies only; never put it in a CV, letter or outbound message.

banned_phrases.description: Single list of phrases that must not appear in any outbound text (letters, form answers, replies, DMs). Case-insensitive substring match. Your list replaces this default.

channel_banned_phrases.description: Extra banned phrases per channel (keys: dm, recruiter_reply, letter, form_answer). Added to banned_phrases.

dm: i'm happy to hear the details first

followup_words.description: Min and max words in a follow-up message.

reply_words_interested.description: Min and max words when replying to a recruiter you are interested in.

reply_words_info.description: Min and max words when asking for details or declining.

form_project_words.description: Project entry on an application form.

replies.description: Language of replies; empty = mirror the recruiter.

address_reader_directly.description: Write letters to the reader (you/your) instead of the company in the third person.

send_window.description: Best days and times to send outreach, as free text.

situation.description: Optional personal context that skills and recruiter replies must respect. Free text; keep it factual.

available_from.description: Start availability (date or phrase), e.g. 2026-12-01 or 'immediately'.

reason_to_give_recruiters.description: One truthful line to give when asked why you are looking or available.

search_priority.description: What the search optimizes for, e.g. fastest offer, maximum money, specific growth.

relocation_messaging.description: How to phrase relocation openness in letters and replies. Plain flexibility, not an apology.

notes.description: Other standing facts or rules (country limits, role priorities, hard no's).

side_hustle_policy.description: What to say (or not say) about other work when a recruiter offers part-time or contract roles.

date_format.description: strftime pattern for dates in letters and CVs.

frozen_facts.description: Facts that must never change when tailoring (employers, titles, dates, numbers).

only_on_request.description: Write a cover letter only when the user asks; never offer one.

contacts_file.description: Workspace-relative file with your contacts or followers.

max_wait_days.description: Days to wait for a referral before a cold application; 0 = never delay.

trusted_ats_domains.description: Apex domains of applicant-tracking systems you accept apply links to. A look-alike host fails closed.

never_mention.description: Topics that must not appear in outbound text.
